facts.fact: Freedom House reports a localized internet shutdown in Tripoli in May 2025 amid antigovernment protests, lasting around 12 hours, with at least one provider reporting a total outage; the source does not name who ordered it.

Freedom House, citing Libya Crimes Watch, reports that Faisal Rajab al-Shikhi was detained in Benghazi in January 2025 by armed men of the Libyan Arab Armed Forces over a Facebook video critical of Khalifa Haftar, and his whereabouts were unknown at period end.
